description: This file contains internal function declarations, macros, and type definitions related to X.509v3 extensions in OpenSSL, including hex encoding/decoding, configuration name matching, DNS name checking, extension caching, IP address decoding, and comparison functions.

methods.name: x509v3_bytes_to_hex
methods.description: Encodes a byte array to a hex string, returning a newly allocated string.

methods.name: x509v3_hex_string_to_bytes
methods.description: Decodes a hex string to a byte array, returning a newly allocated buffer.

methods.name: x509v3_conf_name_matches
methods.description: Checks if a configuration name matches or begins with a given string.

methods.name: x509v3_looks_like_dns_name
methods.description: Determines if input looks like a DNS name.

methods.name: x509v3_cache_extensions
methods.description: Caches extension data in an X509 object.

methods.name: x509v3_a2i_ipadd
methods.description: Decodes an IP address string into binary form.

methods.name: x509V3_add_value_asn1_string
methods.description: Appends a CONF_VALUE with ASN1_STRING data to a list.

methods.name: X509V3_NAME_from_section
methods.description: Adds attributes to an X509_NAME from configuration section data.

methods.name: X509V3_bool_from_string
methods.description: Decodes a string as a boolean value.

methods.name: X509V3_get_value_bool
methods.description: Decodes a CONF_VALUE as a boolean.

methods.name: X509V3_get_value_int
methods.description: Decodes a CONF_VALUE as an integer.

methods.name: X509V3_get_section
methods.description: Retrieves a configuration section from context.

methods.name: X509V3_add_value
methods.description: Appends a name-value pair to a list of CONF_VALUEs.

methods.name: X509V3_add_value_bool
methods.description: Adds a boolean value as a string to a list.

methods.name: X509V3_add_value_int
methods.description: Adds an integer value as a string to a list.

methods.name: X509V3_parse_list
methods.description: Parses a comma-separated list into CONF_VALUE list.

methods.name: GENERAL_NAME_cmp
methods.description: Compares two GENERAL_NAME structures for equality.
